data.description: Post-purchase banner displayed to customers who recently purchased some products from your e-shop. The objective is to gather feedback about their shopping experience and preferences without the need for a consent
data.name: Interactive Post-Purchase Feedback Banner

template.callout: "Engage with customers who recently made a purchase on your e-shop. Gather valuable insights about their shopping experience and learn more about your customer base without seeking consent."

fulfillments.description: The banner steps are in the following order: 'Number Scale Question', 'Multiple Option Question', 'Card Options Question', and 'Picture Scale Question'. Below, you will find additional versions of this banner. The differences between the versions lie in the order of the steps. The banner is fully customizable, allowing you to tailor it to your design and edit the various questions and answers as needed.

fulfillments.description: After launching the campaign, you can return to this evaluation dashboard to see the real-time campaign performance results. Make sure to fill in the parameters inside the dashboard e.g. campaign_name.

fulfillments.description: This report displays the responses submitted for the 'Number Scale' question. Please rename this report to reflect your 'Number Scale' question accurately. No further edits to the report are required
fulfillments.headline: Report on the 'Number Scale' Question

fulfillments.description: This report shows the answers submitted for the 'Picture Scale' question. Please rename this report to mirror your 'Picture Scale' question. No further edits are necessary in the report.
fulfillments.headline: Report on the 'Picture Scale' Question

fulfillments.description: This report shows the answers submitted for the 'Card Options' question. Please rename this report to mirror your 'Card Options' question. In the second step, please rename the metrics to reflect the answers to your question. The first metric corresponds to the first answer, and so on.
fulfillments.headline: Report on the 'Card Options' Question
